series.NFCI: Chicago Fed National Financial Conditions Index

metadata.cadence: mixed daily/weekly/monthly observations aligned to daily last-known values
metadata.vintage: latest-revised observations; not an ALFRED vintage

creditSpreadProxy.label: Moody's Baa-minus-fed-funds historical credit-spread proxy
creditSpreadProxy.limitation: BAAFF is a historical Moody's Baa-minus-fed-funds proxy; it is not equivalent to the ICE/BofA high-yield option-adjusted spread BAMLH0A0HYM2.

limitations: FRED observations are latest revisions rather than point-in-time ALFRED vintages; all experiment results remain research-only.
Each aligned row is available only after the latest contributing observation plus a conservative 30-day lag.
BAAFF is a historical Moody's Baa-minus-fed-funds proxy; it is not equivalent to the ICE/BofA high-yield option-adjusted spread BAMLH0A0HYM2.
